newsitem.title: BULGARIA: GUN FOUND NEAR HOME OF SLAIN BULGARIAN EX-PREMIER.
newsitem.headline: GUN FOUND NEAR HOME OF SLAIN BULGARIAN EX-PREMIER.

text.p: Neighbours of Bulgaria's murdered former premier Andrei Lukanov have found a gun hidden behind a radiator in the entrance hall of their building, local media reported on Friday.

The politician and businessman was shot dead outside his home in an apparent contract killing on October 2. No one has been arrested and any findings from official investigations have not been made public.

State television said the house, in a quiet residential street near Lukanov's home, lay on one of the likely routes the killer would have taken to escape. The gun, with a silencer attached, was wrapped in cloth.
A colleague of Lukanov in the divided Socialist party, Andrey Raichev, said Lukanov was about to expose high-level government corruption when he was killed.

Lukanov was a leading member of the pro-reform wing of the governing Socialists who are at odds with Prime Minister Zhan Videnov and his circle. He was ousted as board chairman of Bulgarian-Russian joint stock company Topenergy in July under government pressure.
